_comment: Legendary raids (raidManager.js rules, RaidWorld.ts in the world). A legendary turns up as a rare event (a chance each check while you're in the right district at the right time, with a strong enough team) or through a quest step (type raid). It is foreshadowed (omen), then rampages: stomping on a timer, knocking out wild Streetmon, throwing cars and people and wrecking street props. Trainers nearby come running and send their Streetmon at it. Press B near it to join the fight: your team and the trainers' Streetmon against it, and it acts twice as often (twice a turn in turn-based battles; each hit at foeDamage strength, so it's relentless rather than one-shotting). Its HP carries over between fights (the trainers chip at it too). Beat it and it's subdued for a short window: throw a capture item. If you lose, run, or leave it too long, it escapes and won't be back until its cooldown has passed. Times in seconds of play.

cheerLines: Don't let it near the block!

legendaries.omen: Every car alarm on the block is going off at once...
legendaries.escaped: Gridlock shoulders through the jam and is gone. The alarms fall quiet.
legendaries.subdued: Gridlock sinks to one knee, engine-steam pouring off it. Throw something, now!
legendaries.caught: You caught Gridlock! The city's traffic seems to breathe out.

legendaries.omen: The street lamps are flickering, one block after another...
legendaries.escaped: Blackout fades into the dark between two lamps. The lights come back on.
legendaries.subdued: Blackout's glow gutters out and it sinks to the pavement. Throw something, now!
legendaries.caught: You caught Blackout! Every light on the avenue flares at once.

legendaries.omen: The pipes are humming. The water's rising...
legendaries.escaped: Undertow slides back under the black water. The humming fades.
legendaries.subdued: Undertow's hum drops to nothing and it slumps in the shallows. Throw something, now!
legendaries.caught: You caught Undertow! The water in the tunnels goes still.
